praise.title: Huge, explorable open world
praise.detail: The most common praise in every language: a vast, handcrafted world with endless things to discover, strong immersion, and a feeling of freedom.
praise.quote: very immersive world with endless exploration

praise.title: Visuals and scenery
praise.detail: Graphics and scenery are called some of the best in the genre, mostly by players with capable hardware.

praise.title: Combat and variety of activities
praise.detail: Fluid, satisfying combat plus a long list of side activities (crafting, trading, hunting, mini-games, housing) that keep players going for hundreds of hours.

praise.title: Post-launch support
praise.detail: Players notice the 2.0 / Enhanced updates, quick patches and the developer's attitude, and many look forward to the DLC.
praise.quote: quality of life improvements since launch ... makes this, in my opinion, GOTY

complaints.title: Puzzles with no guidance
complaints.detail: Abyss and other puzzles are the most repeated complaint among Korean and Chinese reviewers and also come up in English; many say they cannot be solved without a guide.
complaints.quote: Greatest game with the absolute stupidest puzzle system ever.

complaints.title: Crashes, launch failures and optimization
complaints.detail: A large share of negative reviews are about crashing on launch, in the map or inventory, freezes, shimmering or blurry graphics and heavy reliance on ray reconstruction.

complaints.title: Controls and interaction
complaints.detail: Clunky, unresponsive dodge and interaction, too many key combinations, weak gamepad camera and lock-on.

complaints.title: Story, characters and quest design
complaints.detail: Story called weak or confusing even after the update; quests padded with fetch tasks and slow follow-the-NPC sections; unclear objectives.

complaints.title: Content feels wide but shallow
complaints.detail: Many mechanics but little depth, and boss fights criticized for stunlocks and one-hit mechanics.
complaints.quote: Wide as an ocean, deep as a puddle.

praise.title: Open world and immersion
praise.detail: Compared to Skyrim, Witcher 3 and Red Dead 2: a populated, immersive world with a huge amount to do.
praise.quote: I honestly haven't felt this invested in a world since Skyrim.

praise.title: Graphics and combat
praise.detail: Beautiful visuals and satisfying combat are the other most-named strengths.

praise.title: Value and hours of content
praise.detail: Many players report 100 to 300+ hours with plenty left; several call it a game of the year candidate.

praise.title: Improved since launch
praise.detail: Reviewers mention 2.0 and Enhanced as clear improvements, including the story, and look forward to the DLC.

complaints.title: Crashes and failure to launch
complaints.detail: The single biggest English complaint: crashes on the main menu, the map or inventory, GPU hangs, and refund frustration.

complaints.title: Clunky controls
complaints.detail: Dodge and interaction feel unreliable, key bindings are limited, and there are too many steps for simple actions.

complaints.title: Weak story and tedious quests
complaints.detail: Story and characters described as boring or incoherent; side quests padded with fetching and slow NPC escorts.
complaints.quote: The characters are as deep as a puddle

complaints.title: Puzzles and poor guidance
complaints.detail: Puzzles are called boring or unfair, and the game rarely tells players what to do or how systems work.

complaints.title: Boss design and shallow systems
complaints.detail: Bosses criticized for stunlocks and no proper dodge or parry; inventory limits and many shallow mechanics.

praise.title: Exploration and vast world
praise.detail: Freedom to explore anywhere is the most cited strength; players say there is always more to do.

praise.title: Fun and sheer amount of content
praise.detail: Described as very fun overall, with strong graphics and a huge amount to do.

praise.title: Developer response
praise.detail: Quick patching after problems is praised, and several players bought or pre-ordered the DLC.

praise.title: Story improved
praise.detail: Several say the story is better after Enhanced, though it is not Red Dead 2 level.

complaints.title: Abyss and other puzzles
complaints.detail: The most frequent complaint: puzzles are stressful, give no clear direction and are seen as padding playtime.

complaints.title: Controls and combat feel
complaints.detail: Several reviews call the controls and responsiveness poor, on both gamepad and keyboard.

complaints.title: Weak story and unfriendly guidance
complaints.detail: Not explaining what to do, a dull story and a protagonist some find hard to connect with.

complaints.title: Bugs
complaints.detail: Reports of Kliff's voice disappearing, NPC loading blocking paths, and map loading issues.

praise.title: Scenery and visuals
praise.detail: Landscapes, towns and character models are called among the best in current open-world games.

praise.title: Large world and rich content
praise.detail: A vast map with lots to do and a lot of freedom: combat variety, trading, housing, dyeing and clothing.

praise.title: Combat feel and builds
praise.detail: Many weapons and skill options and satisfying combat for players who stick with it.

praise.title: Mods and the developer's attitude
praise.detail: Active mods are said to cover the control weaknesses, and the developer is credited for continued updates.

complaints.title: Puzzles without guidance
complaints.detail: By far the most repeated complaint: players say many puzzles cannot be solved without looking up a guide.

complaints.title: Story and quest quality
complaints.detail: The main story is called thin or filler, characters shallow, and side quests repetitive with slow follow-the-NPC sections.

complaints.title: Controls and interaction
complaints.detail: Poor response, too many key combinations, awkward gamepad lock-on, and slow climbing or interaction.

complaints.title: Optimization and crashes
complaints.detail: Freezes and crashes when opening the map or inventory, rough lighting without ray reconstruction, and performance cost.

complaints.title: Boss fights
complaints.detail: Some boss designs are called unfair or built around invincibility and attacks that are hard to avoid.
